title: Hydrogen production via electrolysis and ultrasound-assisted sonoelectrolysis: evaluating NiO, CoO, and MnO2 catalyst performance and process efficiency
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00325C, Paper

Yew Heng Teoh, Wong Yang Han, Heoy Geok How, Haseeb Yaqoob, Mohamad Yusof Idroas, Saad Uddin Mahmud, Thanh Danh Le, Muhammad Ahmad, Muhammad Wakil Shahzad
NiO, CoO, and MnO2 improve H2 generation via electrolysis and sonoelectrolysis. DOE/RSM identify NiO at 60 °C as optimal. Sonoelectrolysis increases H2 rates but reduces energy efficiency due to ultrasonic power input.
